verdicts.reason: Both crops cut off the cake base and tray, which leaves the figs floating with no context. In both, the wreath's lower sprigs run into the fig slice and grapes, and the headline sits on a busy photo area. A keeps the 'Perfect Taste' lockup bigger and more dominant, closer to the original's hierarchy. B shrinks the lockup so it looks timid and underweighted, with more dead dark space above and around it.
